mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate directly reduces the discount rate for equity valuation, leading to higher S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in >60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.05%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which typically leads to reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in >60% of periods when UNRATE rises >0.3pp in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) increase while industrial production (INDPRO) decreases, it indicates a demand-supply imbalance that triggers inflationary pressures and monetary tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in >60% of periods when HOUST rises and INDPRO falls.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.5% year-over-year), the Federal Reserve is likely to tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in >60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 3.5% year-over-year.

mechanism_narrative: Strong retail sales (RSAFS) indicate robust consumer demand, which supports corporate revenue growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in >60% of periods when RSAFS is above its 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals an imminent economic slowdown, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in >60% of periods when INDPRO falls >1.0pp in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises while the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) remains low, it indicates a labor market weakness without monetary support, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: labor market weakness with accommodative policy
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in >60% of periods when UNRATE rises and FEDFUNDS is below 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: During housing market expansions (HOUST above 1400 thousand units), strong housing activity drives consumer confidence and economic growth, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in >60% of periods when HOUST is above 1400 thousand units.
